title: Clockwork Corset Forge
description: A steampunk forge where interlocking gears power a mechanical assembly line that shapes and ornaments a corset. The user manipulates gear speeds, torque distribution, and material channels to craft a finished corset while obeying energy conservation laws, with full undo/redo support for every action.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls. Load 'shared_assets/gears.glb' and 'shared_assets/Corset.glb'. Scene setup: dark industrial backdrop with a PerspectiveCamera at (0,2,5), ambient light (0x334455, 0.3), two warm point lights simulating forge glow, and one directional light. Place the gears model on the left as a mechanical drive system and the corset model on the right on a rotating pedestal. Create an HTML overlay panel with these controls: (1) Three sliders labeled 'Drive Gear RPM', 'Transfer Ratio', and 'Polish Intensity' each ranging 0-100. (2) Three toggle buttons for material channels: 'Bronze Plate', 'Leather Weave', 'Gem Inlay' that apply metalness/roughness/emissive changes to the corset's materials. (3) A 'Forge Strike' button that commits the current configuration as a shaping step. (4) Undo and Redo buttons. Interaction logic: Changing Drive Gear RPM animates the gears model rotation speed proportionally. Transfer Ratio couples gear rotation to the corset pedestal spin rate — higher ratio means faster corset spin but reduces available Polish Intensity maximum (energy conservation: RPM × TransferRatio + PolishIntensity must stay ≤ 150; auto-clamp Polish slider). Polish Intensity controls a bloom-like emissive glow on the corset. Each 'Forge Strike' saves the full state (all slider values, active material channels) onto a history stack. Undo restores the previous state and visually reverts the corset appearance; Redo re-applies. Require at least 10 meaningful steps: user must toggle each material channel at least once, adjust each slider at least twice, press Forge Strike at least 3 times, and use Undo then Redo at least once. Display a step counter and a progress checklist on screen. When all checklist items are satisfied, show a 'Forging Complete' banner with particle sparks. Gears should always visually spin based on current RPM. The corset should reflect all active material channel modifications in real time.
